mcqs.learning_point: Understand rational numbers as numbers expressible as a quotient of integers with non-zero denominator
mcqs.question: Which of the following expressions does NOT represent a rational number?
mcqs.explanation: A rational number must be written as a quotient of two integers where the denominator is not zero. Options A (5/8), B (-3/7) and C (0 = 0/1) all satisfy this. Option D has denominator zero, making the expression undefined, so it is not a rational number.

mcqs.learning_point: Recognise positive and negative rational numbers
mcqs.question: Which of the following statements correctly identifies the positive rational numbers among the list? -2/5, 3/4, -7, 0.5

options.C: All of them are negative rational numbers
options.D: None of them are rational numbers

mcqs.explanation: Positive rational numbers are those greater than zero. 3/4 (=0.75) and 0.5 are greater than zero, so they are positive rational numbers. -2/5 and -7 are negative. All listed numbers are rational because each can be expressed as a quotient of integers with a non‑zero denominator. Hence option B is correct.

mcqs.learning_point: Represent rational numbers on a number line
mcqs.question: On a standard horizontal number line, which point correctly represents the rational number -3/4?

options.A: A point to the right of 0 at a distance of 0.75 units
options.B: A point to the left of 0 at a distance of 0.75 units
options.D: A point to the left of 0 at a distance of 1.25 units

mcqs.answer: A point to the left of 0 at a distance of 0.75 units
mcqs.explanation: -3/4 is negative, so it lies to the left of 0. Its magnitude is 3/4 = 0.75, therefore it is placed 0.75 units left of the origin. Option B describes exactly this location. Option A is on the right side, C is at the origin, and D is farther left than -3/4.

mcqs.question: Which of the following rational numbers is the greatest?
mcqs.explanation: Convert each to decimal: -2/3 ≈ -0.666, 5/8 = 0.625, 3/4 = 0.75, 2/5 = 0.40. The largest value is 0.75, which corresponds to 3/4. Therefore option C is the greatest rational number among the choices.
